desktopUpdate.readyHelp: The update is downloaded and verified. Restarting closes the app briefly and reopens it as {{version}}. Save your work first.
desktopUpdate.manualHelp: Click Update to download and request a safe restart. Checks never download or install updates.
desktopUpdate.awaitingOperation: Waiting for the previous native operation to finish. Do not retry yet.
desktopUpdate.deferredHelp: Finish active work, then check again. Installation will not retry automatically.
desktopUpdate.recoveryHelp: Recovery needs attention in the desktop app. Only status refresh is available here.

updateErrors.busy: Active work blocked the restart. Finish that work, then click Update again.
updateErrors.changed: The update target changed. Review the version shown before clicking Update again.
updateErrors.failed: The update could not complete. Check its status, then try again.

reasons.preferencesNotPersisted: The automatic check setting could not be saved.
reasons.discoveryRateLimited: GitHub's anonymous API limit was reached. The next check runs automatically after the limit resets.

desktopUpdate.title: Desktop updates
desktopUpdate.unconfirmed: Desktop updater access has not been confirmed.
desktopUpdate.lastConfirmed: Last confirmed native state; the current state is not confirmed.
desktopUpdate.incomplete: Release discovery is incomplete. This is not a claim that the latest version was found.
desktopUpdate.preparationOnly: Installation is currently unavailable. A prepared update is not an installed update.
desktopUpdate.automaticHelp: Checks only look for new releases. Downloads and installation require clicking Update. Setting changes appear after desktop confirmation.
desktopUpdate.confirmingSetting: Waiting for native confirmation of this setting…
desktopUpdate.osPrompt: macOS may ask for administrator approval in its own system dialog. Approve or cancel there; do not enter credentials here. Restart may be deferred while work is active.

errors.unavailable: Cannot reach the authenticated desktop updater. Its current state is unknown.
errors.invalidResponse: The desktop updater returned an unsupported response. Installation controls remain disabled.
errors.timeout: Stopped waiting for a response; the native operation may still be running. Refresh status before retrying.

account.languageDescription: Choose the language used by the interface

voiceSettings.title: Voice
voiceSettings.description: Speech input and read-aloud through an OpenAI-compatible audio service.
voiceSettings.enableDescription: Add microphone and read-aloud controls to messages.
voiceSettings.backendDescription: Use OpenAI, Groq, or a local service such as LocalAI, Speaches, or Kokoro-FastAPI. Leave empty for the server default.
voiceSettings.note: The browser contacts a custom base URL directly, so it must allow CORS. Leave it empty to use the server backend.

preferences.sendByCtrlEnterDescription: When enabled, Ctrl+Enter sends messages instead of Enter. This helps IME users prevent accidental sends.

toolOutputDensity.label: Tool output density
toolOutputDensity.description: How much of each tool call the transcript shows before you open it.
toolOutputDensity.compactDescription: Every call is one folded row. Diffs show the file and its +N/−M, and reasoning and raw parameters stay hidden.
toolOutputDensity.balancedDescription: Repeated calls fold into one row, command output stays folded and diffs stay open. Reasoning and raw parameters stay hidden.
toolOutputDensity.detailedDescription: Every call is its own card with output, diffs, reasoning and raw parameters open.

automation.title: Browser and native applications
automation.description: Review the isolated Chromium runtime and the separately installed CUA Driver.
automation.notDownloaded: Downloads when the Browser panel first opens
automation.grantsDescription: Only targets marked Always allow are saved.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose which events can notify you.

desktop.title: Desktop app notifications
desktop.enabled: This desktop app can show notifications
desktop.unsupported: This system does not support desktop notifications.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Play a brief sound when a chat run ends or needs tool approval.

darkMode.label: Dark theme
darkMode.description: Switch between light and dark themes

interfaceFontSize.label: Interface text size
interfaceFontSize.description: Set text size throughout chats, sessions, settings, and the interface

imagePreviews.label: Image attachment previews
imagePreviews.description: Load image attachments in conversation history

git.title: Git settings
git.description: Set the Git identity used for commits. It is written globally with git config --global.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Per-project rules for what the agent may run without asking. Projects on the default policy (Ask, nothing always allowed) are not listed.
permissions.empty: Every project asks before running commands.
